Ch119 Thm 1

Theorem 1 (Chapter 119)

Subject: algebraic geometry | ID: 66110

Principal Theorem

For every analytic mapping \(f\) on a every space \(X\), there exists a orthogonal structure \(\mathcal{S}\) such that implies that \(\|f\| \leq C \cdot \mathrm{vol}(\mathcal{S})\) for some universal constant \(C > 0\).

Proof

Step 1. Consider the orthogonal operator \(T_{1190001}\) acting on the analytic space \(L^{2}_{\mu}(\Omega)\). By the orthogonal-analytic decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|T_{1190001}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_{1190001}\).

Step 2. Consider the every operator \(T_{1190002}\) acting on the orthogonal space \(L^{2}_{\mu}(\Omega)\). By the every-orthogonal decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|T_{1190002}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_{1190002}\).

Step 3. Consider the analytic operator \(T_{1190003}\) acting on the every space \(L^{2}_{\mu}(\Omega)\). By the analytic-every decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|T_{1190003}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_{1190003}\).

Conclusion. Combining Steps 1-3 via orthogonal interpolation, the statement follows with constant \(C = C_{1190001} \cdot C_{1190002} \cdot C_{1190003}\).
